programme.desc: Shimmer, Shine and Leah travel to a magical new land called Zahramay Skies and meet Adara, the Stardust Princess. But when Zeta shows up and lets all of Adara's stars loose, the girls must work together to retrieve the stars and save Zahramay Skies.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Zeta traps the girls in a magic bubble, Tala, Nahal and Parisa team up with the girls' Zahracorns to free them. Shimmer, Shine and Leah meet Rubi, a Rainbow Genie-In-Training, whose rainbows quickly get out of control.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When costumes get magically stuck on Shimmer, Shine and Leah, they must track down a special feather to undo the magic. Zeta impersonates the girls' potions teacher and tricks them into helping her brew a sneaky potion.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer and Zahrora accidentally cause some trouble when they visit a new part of Zahramay Skies called Zahraconia. The girls meet Shaya's twin brother Shaun and help them when their magic combines to form a powerful Lightning Burst Cloud.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When flight magic disappears from Zahramay Skies, Rubi and the girls try to set things right, using rainbows to get around. When Zeta combines Daydream Dust with Dream Come True Dust, genies' daydreams start coming true and wreaking havoc.
programme.sub-title: Rainbows To The Rescue/Daydreams Come True

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La princesse canadienne est kidnappée pendant sa cérémonie de mariage, Ike est convoqué au Canada pour aider à la retrouver. Qui peut bien être l'auteur d'un tel crime?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après un incident embarrassant impliquant les parties des garçons, Cartman est envoyé en thérapie de 'gestion de la colère' et Randy fait de son mieux pour gérer les retombées.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Kyle découvre que Cartman se porte bénévole pour les bébés accros au crack dans l'hôpital de la ville, il commence à douter. Que fait Slash (des Guns n' Roses) dans tout ça?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Butters est pris dans une guerre de territoire asiatique, ses parents découvrent qu'il a plusieurs personnalités et décident que la seule solution est de lui administrer des médicaments.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour son anniversaire, Stan reçoit en cadeau un CD de 'tween wave' mais ses parents lui interdisent d'écouter cette 'merde'. Stan se surprend à être d'accord avec eux, mais ses amis n'en sont pas impressionnés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan continue d'avoir sa crise existentielle alors que Cartman intègre le monde du hamburger avec un ingrédient super spécial, top secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un jeu de 'garde-frontières' termine mal et Butters finit par faire revivre la fierté mexicaine, mais Cartman n'est pas prêt à laisser le jeu se terminer ainsi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque l'école primaire de South Park est victime d'un site internet dévoilant les secrets de tous, c'est l'hécatombe. Qui sauvera la situation? Cartman ou Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Randy apprend le secret qui se cache derrière la comédie musicale, il ne peut s'empêcher d'y emmener Sharon. Andrew Lloyd-Webber et Elton John le supplient de ne pas révéler leur secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après la visite à l'école d'un intervenant venu expliquer les affres du harcèlement, Stan décide de réaliser un clip vidéo (sous forme de lip dub) pour sensibiliser le reste du monde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Stan, Kyle et Kenny partent en excursion dans les Rocheuses du Colorado pour y découvrir la tyrolienne. Le voyage des enfants va rapidement virer au cauchemar.
programme.sub-title: Je n'aurais jamais dû faire de la tyrolienne

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'arrivée d'une nouvelle camarade de classe de couleur va donner envie à Cartman de mettre en application ses conceptions personnelles sur l'amour et les races, en tentant de la faire tomber amoureuse du petit Token Black.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh change radicalement les règles du football à l'école élémentaire de South Park. Sa nouvelle version du jeu devient le sport le plus populaire du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman prend conscience de son poids et décide de conduire un scooter pour handicapé. Kyle constate que de plus en plus de personnes mènent sans honte ce genre de vie autour de lui. C'est alors que Cartman se découvre une rivale.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de Randy pour Halloween empêchent Stan de pouvoir aller à la chasse aux bonbons avec ses amis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ayant appris que Jésus s'était dopé pour accomplir ses miracles, le monde se sent perdu et trahi. Les garçons, joints par le reste de la nation, retirent les bracelets jaunes symbolisant leur ancienne idole.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman cache un terrible secret dans sa chambre à coucher qui pourrait changer les élections présidentielles 2012 aux États-unis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle est en colère contre Cartman qui a pris la mauvaise habitude de parler au téléphone avec le haut-parleur, et l'accuse de se mêler de sa vie privée. Cartman informe alors les autres élèves de l'école que le gouvernement les espionne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a appris que George Zimmerman n'était pas coupable du meurtre de Trayvon Martin, un jeune noir dans un quartier résidentiel aux Etats-Unis, Cartman est perturbé par une personne qu'il considère comme une menace pour l'humanité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, une des gothiques de l'école, est envoyée dans un camp pour enfants en difficulté. Elle en revient transformée en emo. En l'apercevant, les autres gothiques vont paniquer et demander de l'aide aux vampires.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Monsieur Mackey annonce aux élèves de South Park que l'école est maintenant dotée d'un nouveau système informatique : "Intellilink". En essayant d'en faire une démonstration, il s'avère que celui-ci ne fonctionne pas comme prévu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de la plus grosse journée de shopping de l'année ont commencé. L'hiver approche et cela ne peut signifier qu'une seule chose : la lutte pour être le premier à entrer dans le centre commercial le fameux "Vendredi noir" est lancée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le black friday approche, les armées des clans de Cartman et Kenny vont s'affronter dans un bain de sang, l'enjeu : les nouvelles consoles de jeu vidéo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet épisode est la bataille final entre les pro X-BOX one et PS4, les deux clans plmus que jamais divisés vont se battre jusqu'au bout pour défendre leur console préférée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park découvre Photoshop et son pouvoir d'amélioration physique. Et Wendy va tout faire pour montrer aux garçons que ce n'est pas la vérité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Afin de ne plus être obligés d'aller à l'école ou de faire quoi que ce soit, Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny et Butters décident de créer leur startup en utilisant Kickstarter pour la financer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Mackey agace tout le monde à propos de son régime alimentaire sans gluten. Après avoir été témoins des risques liés au gluten, les habitants changent radicalement leur comportement alimentaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dans le but d'utiliser les toilettes des filles pour échapper aux toilettes bondés des garçons, Cartman annonce qu'il est transgenre. Pendant ce temps, Randy se démène avec sa double identité de Lorde.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man's refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
programme.sub-title: STRAW HAT TEAM ARRIVES! TENSION GROWS AT THE BATTLEFIELD

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
programme.sub-title: EVEN IF IT MEANS DEATH! LUFFY VS. THE NAVY; THE BATTLE STARTS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy's own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
programme.sub-title: HARD BATTLES, ONE AFTER ANOTHER! DEVIL FRUIT EATERS VS. DEVIL FRUIT EATERS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san's Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
programme.sub-title: KUMA'S TRANSFORMATION! IVA'S BLOW OF ANGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy's onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren't ready to give up the fight!
programme.sub-title: THE GREAT SWORDSMAN MIHAWK! LUFFY COMES UNDER THE ATTACK OF THE BLACK SWORD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
programme.sub-title: THE EXTERMINATION STRATEGY IN ACTION! THE POWER OF THE PACIFISTAS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard is betrayed – and brutally stabbed – by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy's defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
programme.sub-title: THE ENCIRCLING WALLS ACTIVATED! THE WHITEBEARD PIRATES BACKED INTO A CORNER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
programme.sub-title: EXECUTION ORDER ISSUED! BREAK THROUGH THE ENCIRCLING WALLS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile's unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
programme.sub-title: MOVING INTO THE FINAL PHASE! WHITEBEARD'S TRUMP CARD FOR RECOVERY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY AT THE END OF HIS TETHER! AN ALL-OUT BATTLE AT THE ORIS PLAZA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a troubled youth seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
programme.sub-title: THE POWER THAT WILL SHORTEN ONE'S LIFE! ENERGY HORMONE, REDUX!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner's swords hovering above Ace's head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
programme.sub-title: TO LIVE UP TO A PROMISE! LUFFY AND COBY COLLIDE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
programme.sub-title: THE SCAFFOLD AT LAST! THE WAY TO ACE HAS OPENED!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight – his own grandfather – in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won't be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide backup!
programme.sub-title: EACH ON DIFFERENT PATHS! LUFFY VS. GARP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Despite Whitebeard's order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
programme.sub-title: THE POWER THAT CAN BURN EVEN FIRE! AKAINU'S RUTHLESS PURSUIT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
programme.sub-title: LOOKING FOR THE ANSWER! FIRE FIST ACE DIES ON THE BATTLEFIELD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace's tragic death. Luffy – paralyzed by grief – must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
programme.sub-title: THE NAVY HEADQUARTERS FALLS! WHITEBEARD'S UNSPEAKABLE WRATH!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard's children watch in horror as the old man faces off against the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never runs away from a fight!
programme.sub-title: ENDING THE MATTER! WHITEBEARD VS. THE BLACKBEARD PIRATES!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The world reacts to Whitebeard's death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy. Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
programme.sub-title: THE SHOW BEGINS! BLACKBEARD'S PLOT IS REVEALED!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy's desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu's fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
programme.sub-title: THE INSATIABLE AKAINU! LAVA FISTS PUMMEL LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route. Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-haired marine changes the world with a scream!
programme.sub-title: THE DESPERATE SCREAM! COURAGEOUS MOMENTS THAT WILL CHANGE THE FUTURE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
programme.sub-title: HERE COMES SHANKS! THE WAR OF THE BEST IS FINALLY OVER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard's death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy's friends fear that Ace's death may be more than the rubber-man can handle – if he ever wakes up!
programme.sub-title: MIGHTY LEADERS FACE EACH OTHER DOWN! HERALDING THE 'NEW ERA'!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard. Luffy's nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
programme.sub-title: LANDING AT THE MAIDEN ISLAND! THE HARSH REALITY FALLS UPON LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One Piece X Toriko Crossover

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY AND ACE! THE STORY OF HOW THE BROTHERS MET!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
programme.sub-title: HERE COMES SABO! THE BOY AT THE GRAY TERMINAL!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight – even when he's outnumbered!
programme.sub-title: I WON'T RUN! ACE'S DESPERATE RESCUE OPERATION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend's past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates and hoist a toast to brotherhood!
programme.sub-title: TO THE SEA SOMEDAY! THE PLEDGE OF THE THREE BRATS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!
programme.sub-title: LEAVING THE DADAN FAMILY FOR GOOD?! THE KIDS' HIDEOUT HAS BEEN BUILT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that's been stealing their food. Ace gets angry when his father's identity is revealed. Sabo's parents hire pirates to track down their son!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY BECOMING AN APPRENTICE?! A MAN WHO FOUGHT AGAINST THE KING OF THE PIRATES!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeat the big tiger – and becoming a good captain!
programme.sub-title: THE BATTLE AGAINST THE BIG TIGER! WHO IS GOING TO BE CAPTAIN?!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find a little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Today's Benny's Sing-Along Party where Dora and Benny are going to sing a very special song together! C'mon, let's all sing-along!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots take a rainbow butterfly, Mariposa, to the Butterfly Ball where everybody gets to have wings.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure: Join Dora and Diego on an adventure to see Boots and Baby Jaguar's Amazing Animal Circus, featuring Perrito, the kitties, Tico, Isa, Benny, and lots more animal friends!
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and her cousin Diego are on their way to a big surprise. It's Boots and Baby Jaguar's Amazing Animal Circus!
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots become book explorers and enter the worlds of Peter Pan, the Wizard of Oz, and Little Red Riding Hood so they can find missing objects for the library's Story Wall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Super Soccer Showdown: Dora travels to Brazil to play in the Big Cup Soccer Tournament, and if her team can beat the Monsters, they'll win the big cup.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora in Wonderland: While Dora's kitties run through a magic mirror, Dora becomes Dora in Wonderland! Join her and Boots on a double-length adventure through the magical, mixed-up world of Wonderland!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Royal Rescue: Dora and Boots and the noble horse, Rocinante, are off to Story Castle to rescue Don Quixote from the evil wizard, Malambruno.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves and fairies from the forest!
programme.sub-title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Big Birthday Adventure: Happy Birthday, Dora! In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom: Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A Greedy King has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Mermaids: It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid. Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's World Adventure: All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day! But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Lost and Found: Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Hic-Boom-Ohhh: What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate. They'll have to go across the Noisy River, then tiptoe through the Quiet Forest, and that's how they'll get to Yellow Valley to find the sound.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Ice Cream: Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Choo Choo: All aboard! It's time for the big train race. First train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Treasure Island: Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Three L'il Piggies: Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big River: Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Berry Hunt: Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful--Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: WizzleWishes: Dora and Boots meet Wizzle who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Grandma's House: Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Surprise: It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Worlds Collide - Part 3: At the secret Federation/military base, the turtles are about to be dissected by Agent Bishop, a very bad resident of planet earth. Luckily, our odd trio of commandos (Splinter, April and Casey) are moving in for the rescue.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Touch and Go: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World. While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hunted: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time … except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: H.A.T.E.: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Nobody's Fool: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: New Blood: The "savior" of New York City, Oroku Saki, has another face: the Shredder. The turtles stumble upon the Shredder's real reason for "helping" New York.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Lesson: April asks the Turtles to help perfect her ninjitsu skills. But the Turtles are reluctant to do so and recount a story about how they once tried to take a "student" under their wing. They just weren't prepared to be teachers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Darkness Within: When Angel's brother disappears in the Wall Street area, the turtles jump to help her. Turns out that, as a result of all the destruction from the invasion, an ancient horror has been stirred.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Mission of Gravity: The Shredder sends Stockman and Hun on a quest to retrieve an Antigravity Generator from the city of Beijing, which is still floating in the upper atmosphere, thanks to the Triceratons.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Entity Below: The Entity and his kind are awakened through a rare planetary alignment, and, harnessing great power, they proceed to start shifting the tectonic plates in order to bring back their world.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Time Travails: The turtles get sucked into a time traveling adventure by the somewhat vapid but totally cute Renet, Apprentice Timestress.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hun on the Run: Hun's always been loyal, but too many failures have tarnished his relationship with his master. But, when Karai is captured by Bishop, the Shredder gives Hun a mission in which he can redeem himself: save Karai and bring her back alive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Reality Check: Ultimate Drako is back and he's causing all sorts of chaos with the Time Scepter. He's sent the four turtles spinning through time into alternate realities.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Across The Universe: Because of Ultimate Drako's machinations, Raphael finds himself in an alternate reality … of the Planet Racers.This right down Raphael's alley … until that alley turns into a dead end and he's heading right for it!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Same as it Never Was: Ultimate Drako's time manipulations have sent Donatello to an alternate reality … and it's not pretty. It's one possible future, a horrible nightmare. The Shredder is all powerful.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Real World - Part 1: Ultimate Drako is causing trouble with the Time Scepter. He blasts Leonardo into another dimension … Usagi Yojimbo's dimension.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Real World - Part 2: Leonardo and Usagi arrive in the Battle Nexus hoping for a way to reunite the four turtles and their master. But, they find the Battle Nexus under the control of the evil Ultimate Drako. Master Splinter is his prisoner.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bishop's Gambit: Bishop is back and making his move. His research demands a mutated specimen closer to human … a rat: Master Splinter. Bishop kidnaps Splinter and moves to finish the creation of his genetically enhanced super soldiers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Exodus - Part 1: Splinter receives a vision of his Master Yoshi…and a mission. He must stop the Shredder.Time is running out. He doesn't know how to explain it to his sons, but they need no explanation.They're with their father to the bitter end.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bad Day: Everything goes from bad to worse for the turtles. Life spins out of control in a nightmare of horror and pain. Who is behind all this? How will it ever end? P.S. Your cat is …

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
